data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $106,371,000 (2022: $75,625,000) is a deterioration of $10,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2022: deterioration $10,434,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate shows an overall gross prioryear strengthening of approximately 17.675 million USD (about 5.96% of opening gross claims outstanding). This net adverse reserve movement is driven by adverse development in older underwriting years (notably 2019 and 2020) partially offset by a release on 2021. The managing agent attributes the movements to recalibration of IBNR and reserving assumptions, loading for inflation and the addition of management margins above actuarial best estimates. The main affected classes are the motor and thirdparty liability portfolios.
raw_causal_phrases: a provision within claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported ("IBNR")
assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business
loading for inflation and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates
back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account on a stand-alone basis
deterioration of $10,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end
data.data_quality_notes: All monetary values are presented in the report's native currency (USD) and are expressed in millions. A direct gross prior-year movement line (gross Insurance liabilities column) was not explicitly provided; prior-year development was therefore calculated from the gross claims development (triangle). The notes also state a net deterioration figure ($10.197m) but that is a net measure; the gross PYD used above (17.675m) is derived from the gross claims development table. The syndicate operated as an SPA in earlier years with reinsurance to/from Syndicate 1969 which may distort some development patterns; this was considered when assessing data quality.
